quantity: delta = RMSE(Physics + residual ML) - RMSE(Stefan, recalibrated) in cm; negative = residual ML better
predictions: data/processed/v5/runs/core_v6/preds: block CV out-of-fold, forcing year_obs, featset F8TS; R1 catboost lam 0.5 (3 seeds averaged), P1
terciles: within-region percentiles (33.3, 66.7) of each covariate over labelled cell-years (np.digitize; ties go to the upper tercile)
interval: polar.testbed_v5.boot_delta, block resampling, 2000 resamples, seed 0, 2.5-97.5 percentiles
shown_rule: n >= 30 cell-years and >= 5 spatial blocks in the tercile

tdd.label: TDD
tdd.definition: thaw degree-days of the observation year, full season (ERA5-Land, degC d)

fdd.label: FDD
fdd.definition: freezing degree-days of the preceding winter, Oct-Apr (ERA5-Land, degC d)

swe.label: Snow (SWE)
swe.definition: mean snow water equivalent of the hydrological year, Oct-Sep (ERA5-Land, m)

soc.label: SOC 0–5 cm
soc.definition: SoilGrids soil organic carbon 0-5 cm (value as stored in static_v5)

clay.label: Clay
clay.definition: SoilGrids clay 5-15 cm (value as stored in static_v5)

ndvi.label: NDVI
ndvi.definition: MODIS summer NDVI, multi-year mean per cell (fill value -3000 treated as missing)
